battle.theater: 西班牙北部納瓦拉與巴斯克山區
battle.brief: 1872年8月2日，帕維亞與普里姆在馬德里發動兵變，迫使阿馬迪奧一世退位流亡，卡洛斯派隨即在納瓦拉、巴斯克與加泰羅尼亞全面起兵，內戰延續三年半。卡洛斯七世兩度自稱國王，政府軍以法製雷管步槍配合青銅砲，在山區逐次攻奪卡洛斯派的小堡，1876年3月維加拉協議後退回法國。

kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 官方一方是西班牙王國的中央政府與北方軍區。1872年8月2日馬德里兵變後，阿馬迪奧一世退位流亡，1873年2月21日制憲議會宣布第一共和國，1874年9月塞拉諾與托佩特的軍事政變解散議會，1874年底起由塞拉諾以「恢復秩序」名義實行威權統治，1875年底阿方索十二世即位恢復波旁王朝。中央權力的骨架是執政內閣、陸軍部與國民警衛隊，警衛隊由波薩達·埃雷拉任總監，1872年後在北方部署數千武裝警員，配合常備軍各團與臨時民兵。北方戰區分設納瓦拉、阿拉瓦、比斯開、吉普斯夸與加泰羅尼亞守軍區，主要據點在帕姆普洛納、維多利亞、聖塞巴斯蒂安、伊倫與比爾巴鄂，政府能調集上萬人的縱隊，但指揮權長期在民政內閣與前線將領之間拉扯，情報與幕僚協作都不順暢。卡洛斯派沒有國家，以流亡巴黎的唐·卡洛斯（卡洛斯七世）為核心，1873年5月率武裝越過比達索阿河回國，先後於莫雷拉與蒙特胡拉自稱國王；北方軍按五個「指揮區」組織，每區由一名將領率領數十個連，每連數十人，另有數百支四至十人的游擊小隊，多為當地農民與獵人，至1874至1875年全軍人數按各方粗估在數萬之譜。他們另有自己的艦隊，以蘇馬拉卡雷吉海軍上將為首，棲根據點在聖塞巴斯蒂安與洪達里比亞，用小型帆船與蒸汽巡洋艦封鎖比斯開灣沿岸。1873年夏天卡塔赫納自治共和國在南方另起爐灶，短暫牽制了政府可調往北方的兵力；共和軍中亦有外國軍事顧問與少數外國志願軍官。
countriesEn: Official Spain was one side: the central government and the northern military district. After the Madrid pronunciamiento of 2 August 1872 forced Amadeo I to abdicate and flee, the Constituent Cortes proclaimed the First Republic on 21 February 1873; the military coups of Serrano and Topete dissolved the Cortes in September 1874, and from late 1874 Serrano governed under a programme of restoration of order, until Alfonso XII's accession in late 1875 brought back the Bourbon monarchy. The backbone of central power was the Council of Ministers, the War Ministry and the Guardia Civil, with José Posada Herrera as the guards' director-general; several thousand armed guards were deployed in the north after 1872, alongside the line regiments and improvised militia. The northern theater was divided into garrison districts for Navarra, Álava, Vizcaya, Guipúzcoa and Cataluña, with the main strongholds at Pamplona, Vitoria, San Sebastián, Irún and Bilbao. The government could concentrate columns of more than ten thousand men, but command authority was permanently split between the civilian cabinet and the generals in the field, and intelligence and staff work were poor. The Carlists had no state of their own: their core was Don Carlos, Carlos VII, exiled in Paris, who returned across the Bidasoa with armed followers in May 1873 and proclaimed himself king first at Morella and then at Montejurra. The Royal Army of the North was organised into five comandancias, each under a general commanding tens of companies of several dozen men, plus several hundred guerrilla bands of four to ten men, mostly local farmers and hunters; rough estimates for 1874 and 1875 put the whole force in the tens of thousands. They also kept their own fleet under Admiral Zumalacárregui, based at San Sebastián and Hondarribía, using small sailing craft and steam corvettes to close the Biscayan coast. In the summer of 1873 the cantonal republic of Cartagena rose in the south and briefly distracted troops the government might have sent north, and in the Republican ranks there were foreign military advisers and a handful of foreign volunteer officers.
people: 卡洛斯七世是整場戰爭的政治核心。他1868年革命後流亡巴黎，1873年5月14日率數百人越境回國，兩度自稱國王，1874年9月27日在奧爾特斯被共和軍擊傷腿部後退入法國，1875年再入西班牙主持軍務，最終在1876年3月與普里姆達成維加拉協議。共和一方最關鍵的人物是加泰隆尼亞出生的將軍胡安·普里姆：1869年任陸軍部長，1872年8月2日與帕維亞合作迫使阿馬迪奧退位，其後出任執政首相，率軍在北方打了三年，1874年12月30日在馬德里阿爾卡拉街遇刺，重傷當夜去世。馬努埃爾·帕維亞在兵變中率部控制維拉埃爾莫薩兵營，後任內政部長；阿方索·卡斯特拉爾主持共和政府的北方防務，1874年赴古巴；弗朗西斯科·塞拉諾1874年9月奪權後主持「威權和平」；海軍上將托佩特同月接管政府並解散議會。卡洛斯派將領中，納瓦拉戰區有早期掌軍的卡巴涅斯，加泰羅尼亞有拉法埃爾·特里斯塔尼，吉普斯夸有弗朗西斯科·薩瓦爾斯，馬埃斯特拉佐則有綽號「栗子」的哈梅，他向村鎮攤派軍需分攤款。安東尼奧·蘇馬拉卡雷吉主持卡洛斯派海軍，1874年12月26日奪取鐵骨裝甲護衛巡洋艦「努曼西亞號」，1875年5月26日再擊沉木殼螺旋槳巡防艦「科瓦東加號」。共和軍一方的關鍵名字還有在聖馬西亞爾兵敗的伊格里巴伊，以及指揮拉卡爾縱隊的外國軍官沙耶費爾。
peopleEn: Carlos VII was the political core of the entire affair. The revolution of 1868 drove him into exile in Paris; on 14 May 1873 he crossed back into Spain with several hundred men, proclaimed himself king twice, was wounded in the leg by the Republican army at Orthez on 27 September 1874 and withdrew to France, returned to Spain in 1875 to direct operations, and finally concluded the Convention of Vergara with Prim in March 1876. The key figure on the Republican side was the Catalan-born general Juan Prim: Minister of War from 1869, he joined Pavía in August 1872 to force Amadeo's abdication, then served as prime minister and led three years of campaigning in the north, until he was shot in the Calle de Alcalá in Madrid on 30 December 1874 and died of his wounds that same night. Manuel Pavía opened the Villahermosa barracks in the coup and later became Interior Minister; Emilio Castelar directed the Republic's northern defence and left for Cuba in 1874; Francisco Serrano seized power in September 1874 and presided over the authoritarian peace; Admiral Topete took over the government in the same month and dissolved the Cortes. Among the Carlist commanders were Cabañes, who led Navarra early in the war, Rafael Tristany in Cataluña, Francisco Savalls in Guipúzcoa, and in the Maestrazgo the man called the chestnut, whose name is spelled in several ways in the sources, who levied the war contribution called the cupo on the villages. Antonio Zumalacárregui commanded the Carlist fleet, seizing the armoured frigate Numancia on 26 December 1874 and sinking the wooden screw frigate Covadonga on 26 May 1875. On the Republican side the names that matter also include Igueribay, defeated at San Marcial, and the foreign officer Schaefer, who commanded the column beaten at Lácar.
kits: 卡面上的雷管步槍是法國1840年制式步槍，擊發靠底火而非火繩，槍身仍為前膛裝填、單發射擊，射程與精度都優於舊式火繩槍。戰場上真正大量服役的，是這條血統末端的作品：法國在1870至1871年戰敗後，把舊式1840年步槍改為「蚱蜢」式後膛槍，配八發彈倉與金屬定裝彈；西班牙軍同期大量採購法國聖艾蒂安貝特朗廠製造的1870年型步槍，軍中俗稱「貝特朗」，設計藍本正是夏塞波特步槍，口徑約十一公釐。共和軍各團配發該型步槍，騎兵與車隊用短管騎槍，後膛槍的十一公釐子彈自1870年代起成為北方各次戰鬥的標準消耗品；卡洛斯軍沒有自己的產能，主要靠繳獲維持，1875年6月聖馬西亞爾一役即繳獲數千支步槍與數門砲。砲兵才是雙方真正的差距所在。政府軍有八公分與十六公分青銅前膛砲、克虜伯十二與十五公分後膛速射砲，另有山地砲連；卡洛斯軍全期只能維持數門八公分青銅砲，多為繳獲，1874年馬埃斯特拉佐的「聖巴巴拉」工場負責修砲與鑄造零星配件，錢幣則在莫雷拉與維斯塔貝利亞的鑄幣所發行。工程方面，雙方都挖「小堡」式野戰胸牆，政府軍以坑道與地雷攻破佩尼亞塞拉多與奧爾杜尼亞，卡洛斯軍用同樣胸牆死守山口。運力靠騾隊、牛車與海運，比爾巴鄂的港口一旦被封鎖，北方政府軍的麵粉與火藥供應立刻吃緊。
kitsEn: The percussion rifle on the card is the French service rifle of 1840: cap ignition instead of a match, still muzzle-loading and single-shot, with more reach and more accuracy than the old matchlock. What actually fought in bulk was the far end of that lineage. After France's defeat in 1870 and 1871, old model 1840 rifles were converted into the grasshopper breech-loading pattern with an eight-round tubular magazine and a metal cartridge; at the same time Spain bought large quantities of the model 1870 rifle built at the Bertrand works of Saint-Étienne, nicknamed el Bertrand by the troops, a design derived from the Chassepot rifle and of about eleven millimetres calibre. Republican regiments were issued that rifle, cavalry and drivers used short carbines, and from the 1870s the eleven-millimetre cartridge became the standard ammunition consumed in every northern action. The Carlists had no manufacturing capacity of their own and lived mainly on captured weapons: at San Marcial in June 1875 they took several thousand rifles and several guns. Artillery was where the two sides really differed. The government had eight- and sixteen-centimetre bronze muzzle-loaders, Krupp twelve- and fifteen-centimetre breech-loading howitzers, and mountain batteries; the Carlists could maintain only a handful of eight-centimetre bronze pieces, mostly captured, and in 1874 the Santa Bárbara workshop in the Maestrazgo repaired guns and cast small parts, while their coins were struck at the mints of Morella and Vistabella. In engineering, both sides dug glorietas, field breastworks and ditches; the government used saps and mines against Peña Cerrada and Orduña, while the Carlists held the same works to seal the mountain passes. Transport ran on mule trains, ox carts and coastal shipping, and once Bilbao's shipping was closed the government's flour and powder for the north ran short within weeks.
tactics: 共和軍的打法是先以縱隊沿大路平行推進，前出散兵與騎兵搜索山道，再以營、團級橫隊在正面展開，砲兵集中射擊制高點，最後以密集步兵反覆衝鋒奪取卡洛斯派設防的小堡。代表戰役是1875年2月佩尼亞塞拉多、奧爾杜尼亞與拉卡爾一役，以及同年6月進攻比爾巴鄂的索莫羅斯特羅：政府軍以重砲與坑道對付山脊上的胸牆，屢攻不下，最終靠封鎖與消耗才迫使守軍退入城內。卡洛斯派打的是典型山地游擊戰：連與小隊分散在山區，靠當地嚮導在夜裡沿稜線移動，於隘口、峽谷與村莊背後突然襲擊，打完即散，盡量避免與敵主力正面決戰；只有當敵軍孤立或分兵時才集結兵力攻擊，例如1875年6月27日聖馬西亞爾一役，卡洛斯派在伊倫附近的聖馬西亞爾山頭集結主力，擊潰伊格里巴伊率領的共和縱隊。卡洛斯派騎兵多為當地牧人出身的輕騎，配騎槍與長矛，陣腳動搖時寧願放棄瞄準改用衝鋒。補給線是雙方共同的弱點：政府軍靠桑坦德等港口海運，再轉騾車入山，冬季泥濘與雪讓運力大減；卡洛斯派則以「分攤」向村鎮徵糧，軍火靠繳獲與境外走私，一旦航路與陸路被切斷就難以為繼。
tacticsEn: Republican practice was to advance parallel columns along the main roads, push skirmishers and cavalry ahead to search the mountain tracks, deploy battalion and regimental lines on the front with the artillery concentrated on the commanding heights, and then send dense infantry forward in repeated assaults to take the Carlist glorietas. The pattern showed at Peña Cerrada, Orduña and Lácar in February 1875, and in the attack on Somorrostro outside Bilbao in June 1875: the government battered the breastworks on the ridge with heavy guns and saps, failed to take them, and only forced the defenders back into the city by blockade and attrition. The Carlists fought a classic mountain guerrilla war: companies and bands dispersed in the hills, moving along the ridgelines at night with local guides, striking suddenly at passes, ravines and behind villages, and dispersing immediately afterwards, avoiding set-piece battle with an enemy main force unless that force was isolated or divided, in which case the Carlists massed to strike. At San Marcial on 27 June 1875 they concentrated their main body on the heights of San Marcial near Irún and routed the Republican column of General Igueribay. Carlist cavalry were light horsemen drawn from local herdsmen, armed with carbines and lances, and when a line began to waver they preferred to charge rather than shoot. Supply was the shared weakness of both sides: the government moved goods by sea to Santander and other ports and then by mule cart into the mountains, and winter mud and snow cut that capacity sharply; the Carlists levied grain on the villages through the cupo and depended on captured or smuggled arms, and once the coastal and inland routes were closed their war effort starved.
data: 時間跨度是1872年8月2日至1876年3月維加拉協議，前後約三年半。兵力方面，卡洛斯派北方軍在1874至1875年按各方粗略估計在數萬之譜，分散於五個指揮區；共和軍在北方可調集上萬人，主要戰役常以五千至一萬人的縱隊行動，而1872年8月2日的馬德里兵變本身只動用了數百名官兵。傷亡數字各方記載出入極大：1874年9月27日奧爾特斯一役，共和軍以一萬人上下的縱隊壓制數千人的卡洛斯軍，卡洛斯七世腿部中彈，卡洛斯軍損失較重；1875年2月的拉卡爾與佩尼亞塞拉多，共和縱隊連連受挫，砲與輜重盡失；1875年6月27日聖馬西亞爾一役是卡洛斯派最大勝利，共和軍損失逾千、卡洛斯軍俘獲約一千二百人，並繳獲六門砲與數千支步槍。海上，1874年12月26日鐵骨裝甲護衛巡洋艦「努曼西亞號」被奪，1875年5月26日木殼螺旋槳巡防艦「科瓦東加號」在比斯開灣被擊沉。步槍手通常每人攜帶七十發備彈，一門砲每分鐘的射擊要耗掉數發炮彈，因此砲兵供應始終比槍彈更緊。1876年巴斯克各省的「平定」行動中，官方公文所報陣亡數在五千至六千之間，各方說法互相矛盾，學界多視為偏高。
dataEn: The war ran from 2 August 1872 to the Convention of Vergara in March 1876, about three and a half years. On numbers: the Carlist Army of the North in 1874 and 1875 is put by rough estimates on all sides at tens of thousands, spread across the five comandancias; the Republicans could bring more than ten thousand into the north, and major operations were usually fought by columns of five to ten thousand men, while the Madrid pronunciamiento of 2 August 1872 itself involved only a few hundred soldiers. Casualty figures vary widely between sources: at Orthez on 27 September 1874 a Republican column of roughly ten thousand men pressed a Carlist force of several thousand, Carlos VII was wounded in the leg and the Carlists lost heavily; in February 1875 Republican columns were beaten in turn at Lácar and Peña Cerrada, losing their guns and baggage; the Carlists' greatest success came at San Marcial on 27 June 1875, when the Republicans lost more than a thousand men, the Carlists took about twelve hundred prisoners and captured six guns and several thousand rifles. At sea, the iron-hulled armoured frigate Numancia was seized on 26 December 1874, and the wooden screw frigate Covadonga was destroyed in the Bay of Biscay on 26 May 1875. Riflemen normally carried seventy rounds, and a gun firing for a minute consumed several shells, so artillery supply was always tighter than small-arms ammunition. In the pacification of the Basque provinces in 1876, official reports gave between five and six thousand dead; the figures contradict one another and scholars generally treat them as high.
cause: 第三次卡洛斯戰爭的根子在一八六八年革命。推翻伊莎貝拉二世後成立的「民主六年期」政府雖於1869年頒布新憲法，後來又迎立薩伏依王朝的阿馬迪奧一世，但阿馬迪奧政府的一系列措施激怒了傳統派：1870年前後修訂的徵兵法把普遍兵役延伸到巴斯克與納瓦拉，廢除了當地的免役特權；煙草專賣與消費稅加重了城鄉負擔；國有化教產與新婚姻法動搖了鄉村的教會秩序；1870年政府一度答應赦免卡洛斯派領袖並許諾改革稅制，事後又反悔，雙方的信任因此崩潰。軍隊內部同樣分裂，不少軍官同情卡洛斯派或屬意阿方索系，一旦中央失勢就隨即倒戈。直接導火線是1872年8月2日馬德里的軍事政變。帕維亞的部隊在維拉埃爾莫薩兵營開火，控制王宮與通訊，阿馬迪奧當夜退位並乘船逃往法國，首都震驚。北方隨即響應：納瓦拉、巴斯克、阿拉瓦與加泰羅尼亞的守軍與地方保皇派起兵，比利牛斯山脈的邊境線迅速被切斷，戰爭自此由一場宮廷政變演成全國性的內戰。西屬古巴的十年戰爭同期未停，國庫本已吃緊，戰事一拉長，前線的糧餉與軍械補充從1873年起就屢屢不濟。
causeEn: The roots of the Third Carlist War lay in the revolution of 1868. The government of the Democratic Sexenio issued a new constitution in 1869 and later welcomed Amadeo I of Savoy, but a series of Amadeo's measures enraged the traditionalists: the conscription law revised around 1870 extended universal military service into the Basque provinces and Navarra and ended their exemption from it; the tobacco monopoly and the consumption taxes loaded the cost on town and country; nationalising church property and the new marriage law disturbed the parish order of the villages; and in 1870 the government briefly promised amnesty to the Carlist leaders and reform of the tax system, then went back on both, which destroyed whatever trust was left. The army itself was split as well, with many officers sympathetic to the Carlists or attached to the Alfonso faction, and they turned over as soon as the centre lost its grip. The immediate spark was the military pronunciamiento of 2 August 1872 in Madrid: Pavía's men opened fire at the Villahermosa barracks, the royal palace and the telegraph were seized, Amadeo abdicated that night and sailed for France, and the capital was stunned. The north answered at once: in Navarra, the Basque provinces, Álava and Cataluña the garrisons and local loyalists rose, the Pyrenean frontier was cut in a few days, and what had been a palace coup became a civil war across the country. The Ten Years' War in Spanish Cuba was still running, the treasury was already exhausted, and once the fighting was prolonged the pay, food and ammunition reaching the front line failed to arrive again and again from 1873.
impact: 這場戰爭是西班牙十九世紀的轉折點。財政上，北方戰事與古巴戰爭同時進行，1873年政府才設立西班牙銀行以整頓貨幣與信貸，中央對各省的調度能力卻始終不足；大量壯丁離鄉，納瓦拉與巴斯克的農田拋荒，馬德里與北方城市的物價與軍價飛漲。政治上，戰爭直接決定了國體走向。1874年塞拉諾掌權後解散議會，1875年阿方索十二世即位，1876年憲法頒布，其中第十三條授權國王在出現「非常狀態」的地區行使特別權，兩年後的巴斯克平定行動正是援引此條而不再經過議會批准；此後的「和平輪替」制度把執政權固定在自由派與保守派兩黨手中，卡洛斯派被排除在議會之外，卡洛斯主義卻在巴斯克與納瓦拉的鄉村以宗派、禮儀與土地糾紛的形式延續，進入二十世紀仍為保守陣營提供象徵。軍事上，這是歐洲最後一批大規模古典式內戰之一，用的仍是線性橫隊與集群青銅砲，卻遇上以步槍精度與快速瞄準為基礎的新射擊技術。結果是線性戰術在山區與內線作戰中屢試不爽，歐洲各國軍隊其後的改建集中在後膛長射程步槍、散兵與機槍三個方向；而卡洛斯派的失敗，也示範了以糧食、軍火與政治認受支撐的游擊軍，比配備精良卻遠離後方的政府縱隊更難以用一次會戰殲滅。
impactEn: This war was a turning point for nineteenth-century Spain. Financially, the northern campaign and the Cuban war ran at the same time, and only in 1873 did the government create the Banco de España to rationalise money and credit, while the centre's ability to move resources to the provinces remained permanently inadequate; large numbers of men were drawn off the land, the fields of Navarra and the Basque provinces went unworked, and prices for food and military stores rose sharply in Madrid and the northern towns. Politically, the war decided the form of the state. After Serrano took power in 1874 and dissolved the Cortes, Alfonso XII came to the throne in 1875 and the Constitution of 1876 was promulgated, its article 135 empowering the king to act in districts in a state of exception; the pacification of the Basque provinces two years later was carried out under that article without a vote of the Cortes. The peaceful alternation that followed fixed power in the hands of the Liberal and Conservative parties and locked the Carlists out of the chamber, yet Carlism itself persisted in the villages of the Basque country and Navarra as a matter of religion, ritual and land, and into the twentieth century it remained a symbol for the conservative camp. Militarily, this was among the last of Europe's large-scale classical civil wars, fought with linear lines and massed bronze guns against new shooting technique built on rifle accuracy and quick aiming. The verdict was that linear tactics failed again and again in mountain and interior operations, and the European rebuild after 1870 turned towards the breech-loading long-range rifle, skirmishers and machine guns; and the Carlist defeat demonstrated that a guerrilla army sustained by food, ammunition and political consent is far harder to annihilate in a single set-piece battle than a well-equipped government column operating far from its bases.
result: 卡洛斯派在戰場上其實沒有被正面殲滅。1875年之後，政府軍在塞拉諾指揮下集中兵力，逐一攻取卡洛斯派控制區，最終促成1876年3月2日在阿爾瓦省維加拉達成的協議：卡洛斯一方放下武器，軍官可保留佩劍，參加戰鬥的人獲得赦免並回鄉，卡洛斯七世退回法國。少數拒絕放下武器的「王派」則在加泰羅尼亞與馬埃斯特拉佐繼續游擊，先後有特里斯塔尼、薩瓦爾斯與拉法埃爾·卡夫雷拉等人，1877年後才被逐一清剿；1876年7月2日的大赦法與其後對巴斯克各省與納瓦拉的「平定」行動，官方報告有數千人陣亡，數字各說各話。國體上，戰爭終結了卡洛斯派以武力爭奪王位的方式，把西班牙推向1875至1876年的波旁復辟與1876年憲法，也讓原本可能把國家推向共和的普里姆派系失去了領袖。回望全場：加泰隆尼亞人普里姆以起義者的身分推翻國王，最後死於街頭暗殺；卡洛斯七世兩度自稱國王，最後靠一份協議退場；雙方的將領都清楚對方不肯屈服，卻也同樣清楚自己的軍隊已無法再撐，而多數士兵在三年半的消耗之後，只想回家。
resultEn: The Carlists were not, in the end, destroyed in the field. After 1875 the government under Serrano concentrated its strength and took the Carlist-held districts one by one, until the Convention of Vergara of 2 March 1876 in the province of Álava: the Carlists laid down their arms, officers kept their swords, the men who had fought received amnesty and were allowed to go home, and Carlos VII withdrew to France. The small body who refused to lay down arms, the Royalists, carried on as guerrillas in Cataluña and the Maestrazgo under Tristany, Savalls and Rafael Cabrera in turn, and were only cleared out one by one after 1877; the general amnesty law of 2 July 1876 and the subsequent pacification of the Basque provinces and Navarra cost, by official count, several thousand dead, on figures nobody agrees. In constitutional terms the war ended the Carlist attempt to win the throne by force and pushed Spain towards the Bourbon restoration of 1875 and 1876 and the Constitution of 1876, while the faction that might have carried Spain towards a republic lost its leader in Prim. Looking back over the whole affair: Prim, a Catalan, toppled a king by pronunciamiento and died from an assassination in the street; Carlos VII proclaimed himself king twice and left the field by a written agreement; both sides' commanders understood that the other would not yield, and equally that their own armies could hold out no longer, and after three and a half years of attrition most of the men simply wanted to go home.
